facts.business: Madhav Marbles and Granites Limited is engaged in the manufacturing, processing, and trading of natural stone surfaces including granite and marble, along with real estate activities.

auditor.name: Nyati & Associates
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion due to non-assessment of impairment for investments and loans in subsidiaries Madhav Ashok Ventures Private Limited (Rs. 3,00,00,000 investment and Rs. 23,80,40,364 loans) and Madhav Natural Stone Surfaces Private Limited (Rs. 86,00,000 investment and Rs. 6,00,79,718 loans), and associate Madhav Surface LLC (Rs. 4,44,68,248 investment), where net worth has been fully eroded.

key_risks: Geopolitical developments and changing tariff regimes affecting international trade
Higher logistics costs and disruptions in global shipping routes
Competition from other stone-producing countries and alternative surface materials
Customer focus on landed cost, delivery timelines, and supply reliability
Impairment risk in subsidiaries and associate with fully eroded net worth
Dependence on single geography (US market mentioned)
facts.related_party_note: Transactions with subsidiaries Madhav Natural Stone Surfaces Private Limited (capital subscription INR 15.49 Lakhs, inter-corporate loans INR 3.05 Lakhs, rent received INR 1.13 Lakhs, interest on unsecured loan INR 36.30 Lakhs) and Madhav Ashok Ventures Private Limited (capital subscription INR 84 Lakhs, inter-corporate loan given INR 72.93 Lakhs, repayment INR 128.00 Lakhs, rent received INR 1.13 Lakhs, expenses INR 11.77 Lakhs, interest on unsecured loan INR 150.13 Lakhs), and associate Madhav Surfaces FZC LLC (expenses incurred, inter-corporate loans, purchase of goods).
